author: Mr_Mushroom99
body:
I am looking for a team to join. I am fairly new I just joined about 2 days ago and am looking for a team. I am very good with offence or defence in DTM. mostly offence though. I am a great pvper and I can control knock back that is taken and given. I have broken 10 monuments so far and I am willing to participate in all events my team will do. I am mostly a CTW and DTM kind of guy. 


If your team requires to have Skype don't try to invite me because I do not have Skype. But, feel free to email me. scrumb@telus.net.

I have a few good strategies and tactics for DTM and CTH. I am a great team player. I do not mon-block or hack. I always play fair and i do not make the other players feel bad by saying that they are bad.
